title: Root multiplicity under an injective coefficient map
statement: Let $K,L$ be fields [def-weil-field], let $f:K\to L$ be an injective unital ring homomorphism, let $U$ be an indeterminate, and let $P\in K[U]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Write $f_*P\in L[U]$ for the polynomial obtained by applying $f$ to every coefficient [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map]. For every $x\in K$, root multiplicity [def-weil-root-multiplicity] satisfies $m_x(P)=m_{f(x)}(f_*P)$. The convention is $m_x(0)=0$, so the assertion includes $P=0$.
